newsitem.title: USA: Weather delays repairs to Texaco crude line.
newsitem.headline: Weather delays repairs to Texaco crude line.

text.p: Texaco Inc said inclement weather has slowed repairs on part of a 340,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude oil pipeline linking Bakersfield to San Francisco, California, early Thursday .
"It is not up yet. I don't have an estimate on when it will be up," a company spokeswoman said, adding there were no supply disruptions to customers.
The line, which ruptured Tuesday, had been expected to resume service within 24 hours.
The shut portion of line carries 120,000 bpd and the remainder, which has stayed open, carries 220,000 bpd.
Crews completed clean-up of the spilled oil Wednesday.
The cause of the rupture remains under investigation.
